test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the number and symbol series given below and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 3 @ 2 ^ @ % \ 8 9 \ / ? 8 7 6 # & # + 7 \ (Right)

How many such symbols are there each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 3 @ 2 ^ @ % \ 8 9 \ / ? 8 7 6 # & # + 7 \ (Right)

Now,

Symbols, each of which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, the needed pattern is: Number — Symbol — Number

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce6da71343cee3988826606f77a74c077a95e83942a4445bb58e6dd65995536f.png] 

 

Thus, there is one symbol, which is immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
